test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

His son-in-laws / have enhanced / his business / within a short period.
solution:
The correct answer is **'His son-in-laws'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The erroneous part is the first segment of the given sentence - *'His son-in-laws'.*
 
• The **plural form son-in-laws **is incorrect. 
 
• The correct plural form of the noun *son-in-law *is **sons-in-law.**

***Correct sentence - ******His sons-in-law** have enhanced his business within a short period.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Compound words create special problems when we need to pluralize them.
 
• As a general rule, the element within the compound that word that is pluralized will receive the plural -s.
 
• For example - son-in-law⇒sons-in-law; daughter-in-law⇒daughters-in-law; partner in crime⇒partners in crime, etc.
